scope: Extend an accepted autonomous demand-to-settlement cycle with deterministic discovery of actual paid closure evidence already committed by the same actor in the same demand scope. Record two consecutive non-vacuous exposures through the accepted RetentionLedger, without caller-supplied operation keys, kept references, route, success flag or clearance claim. This sub-batch stops at honest closure; FT4.3b2 retains capability certification, later retained-route reuse, evidence ablation, unavailable support and the final common FT4 gate.
rules: The public controller is paired to one completed accepted AutonomousCycleController, the same native engine, actor and exact Demand. Discovery accepts only a positive scan bound and interruption flag; it accepts no operation key, kept reference, return chain, shell encounter, route, desired result, clearance value or success flag.

Only committed fully paid same-actor native jobs visible in the native journal may become candidates. Candidate ordering is by finished tick, started tick and stable operation identity, independent of construction or mapping order.

A closure exposure requires one exact owned kept-content chain, an actual complementary-to-native paid return whose successor consumes its predecessor output, a later same-scope paid consumer of that exact kept content and a later non-vacuously evaluated clear Shell encounter for the same demand. The accepted RetentionLedger remains authoritative for continuity and closure.

The controller discovers at most one previously unused valid exposure per step. Reusing an operation pair, changing content revision, interruption, missing return, partial/unpaid work, wrong actor or scope, missing Shell fields or an active Shell effect cannot advance closure.
Demand settlement must already be independently auditable before closure discovery begins. Settlement itself grants neither closure nor capability.

Two consecutive accepted exposures over the same exact kept objects and demand are required. Honest closure records historical membership only; it creates no capability certificate and cannot yet select a retained route.

Checkpoint restoration is paired to the exact native engine and exact settled autonomous-cycle checkpoint and restores the RetentionLedger discovery cursor, used evidence identities, event sequence and closure state byte-for-byte.
TIM, seat dimensionality, native resource defaults, accepted subordinate policies and inherited source remain unchanged.

An independent auditor imports no autonomous-closure controller. It invokes the accepted autonomous-cycle and retention auditors, reconstructs candidate chronology and exact links from raw transactions, and rejects forged actor, scope, payment, return, content, Shell, order or closure claims.

Acceptance requires the twelve exact new methods plus all ninety-five exact FT4.1-FT4.3a predecessor methods, both-setting closure witnesses, strict source freeze and unchanged source. Passing accepts FT4.3b1 only; FT4.3b2 retains certification, later reuse, evidence removal, unavailable support and final parent/common FT4 acceptance.
gate: One hundred seven exact methods pass with zero failures/errors; canonical and workflow witnesses each begin from an independently auditable settled autonomous cycle, discover two exact paid non-vacuous exposures without caller-selected evidence, close honestly under independent reconstruction, match the registered source freeze and leave source unchanged.
next: FT4.3b2 capability certification, later retained-route reuse, evidence ablation, unavailable support, opposition and final common FT4 gate
stop: Preserve failures; two gate failures after correction stops.
